text: Implement autonomous execution loop with task decomposition and self-correction
description: Build the core autonomy loop: discover problems → plan solutions → execute tasks → verify outcomes → submit results. Must include automatic task decomposition (breaking complex ideas into sub-ideas), autonomous decision-making without human prompts, and self-correction when errors occur. The agent should recover from failures and adapt its strategy.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A harness that owns context, stages and verification runs the decompose→execute→verify→reflect loop with any model, so the loop no longer depends on one vendor's CLI agent following MCP prompts.

status.comment: No longer waiting on a human (reviewed 2026-11-08): the harness 5949b781 now runs this loop in the loop-worker — orient → decompose (containers, too-large leaves) | execute (built-in, Claude Code or Codex) → verify (receipts + cross-model verdict) → reflect → record, with budgets, versioned config and traces; self-correction = failed verdicts return the idea to open with the objection, too_large triggers decomposition. Remaining under 5949b781: decomposition quality evaluation (4a5e0b10, running), external verifiers (17dff50a, after the 13/17 Nov calls). Earlier comment: the July machinery was implemented in the wrapped-session path; the frontier then needed human-provided effectors.
